# **NFS Hot Pursuit 2 (PlayStation 2) file specs** #

*Last time updated: 2026-11-10 14:01:59.279937+00:00*

*Generated by [TailsLab](../README.md) from its parser code.*


# **Info by file extensions** #

The disc keeps every file in **NFSHP2/ZZDATA.BIN**, listed by **NFSHP2/ZDIR.BIN**: 12-byte entries (Black Box hash of the file path, 2048-byte sector, size). The paths are not stored: the executable SLUS_203.62 has them (e.g. "TRACKS\TRACKB%d.LZC").

**TRACKS/TRACKB\<track\>.LZC** track bundle (track = location * 10 + variant, locations 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6): sceneries, meshes, track paths and race data. Opened in the track viewer with its textures and sky. COMP-compressed: One of types:<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2TrackBundle](#nfs6ps2trackbundle)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2CarGeometry](#nfs6ps2cargeometry)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2ChunkBundle](#nfs6ps2chunkbundle)<br/>- Bytes

**CARS/\<car\>/GEOMETRY.LZC** car model (COMP-compressed; GEOMETRY.BIN uncompressed): its meshes. Textures are in **CARS/TEXTURES.BIN** and **GLOBAL/GLOBALB.LZC**, which has the car types table (wheels). [Nfs6Ps2CarGeometry](#nfs6ps2cargeometry)

**TRACKS/TEX\<track\>LOCATION.BIN**, **TRACKS/TEX\<track\>TRACK.BIN**, **GLOBAL/\*.BIN** texture packs and other chunk bundles. [Nfs6Ps2ChunkBundle](#nfs6ps2chunkbundle)

Did not find what you need or some given data is wrong? Please submit an
[issue](https://github.com/AndyGura/nfs-resources-converter/issues/new)

### **Nfs6Ps2TrackBundle** ###
#### **Size**: 0..? bytes ####
#### **Description**: Track bundle (TRACKS/TRACKB<track>.LZC, uncompressed; TRACKB<track>.BUN): sceneries and meshes of the world of the track, with its race data (AI paths, collision, ...). Textures are in TRACKS/TEX<track>LOCATION.BIN and TEX<track>TRACK.BIN. NFS Hot Pursuit 2 (PS2) chunk bundle (*.BUN, *.BIN, uncompressed *.LZC): a sequence of chunks, each having 32-bit id, 32-bit payload length and payload; chunks with the highest bit of id set are containers of other chunks. Mesh packs, texture packs and sceneries are decoded, other chunks are kept as raw bytes ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **chunks** | until the end of file\*8..? | Array of `until the end of file` items<br/>Item size: 8..? bytes<br/>Item type: One of types:<br/>- [ZeroChunk](#zerochunk)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2SolidPack](#nfs6ps2solidpack)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2TexturePack](#nfs6ps2texturepack)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2Scenery](#nfs6ps2scenery)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2TrackPath](#nfs6ps2trackpath)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2CarTypeInfos](#nfs6ps2cartypeinfos)<br/>- [UnknownChunk](#unknownchunk) | Chunks |

| 8 | **file_path** | chunk_length | UTF-8 string | Path of the pack, e.g. "TRACK11\Pipeline\Scenery\eLabScenery0.bin" |
### **Nfs6Ps2Mesh** ###
#### **Size**: 8..? bytes ####
#### **Description**: Mesh: header, textures, draw groups and VIF data ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **chunk_id** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x80034002 | Chunk ID |
| 4 | **chunk_length** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Length of the chunk payload in bytes (everything after this field) |
| 8 | **sub_chunks** | until the end of chunk\*8..? | Array of `until the end of chunk` items<br/>Item size: 8..? bytes<br/>Item type: One of types:<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2MeshHeader](#nfs6ps2meshheader)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2MeshTextures](#nfs6ps2meshtextures)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2MeshDrawGroups](#nfs6ps2meshdrawgroups)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2MeshVifData](#nfs6ps2meshvifdata)<br/>- [UnknownChunk](#unknownchunk) | Child chunks. Unknown ones: 0x3401D (8-byte records), 0x34007, 0x34012, 0x34011 |
### **Nfs6Ps2MeshHeader** ###
#### **Size**: 200..? bytes ####
#### **Description**: Mesh header: id, name, amounts, bounding box and the transformation of the mesh in the modelling tool ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **chunk_id** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x34003 | Chunk ID |
| 4 | **chunk_length** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Length of the chunk payload in bytes (everything after this field) |
| 8 | **elevens** | up to 16-bytes alignment | Bytes | Alignment filler: a run of 0x11 bytes before the actual payload, so that the payload starts at an aligned offset |
| 8 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **runtime_pointers** | 8 | Bytes | List links, written by the game when the mesh is loaded |
| 16 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **mesh_id** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Mesh id: Black Box hash of the name (`bin_hash`) in most meshes, used by scenery definitions |
| 20 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **version** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Always 11 |
| 24 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **name** | 24 | UTF-8 string | Mesh name, e.g. "TRN_SECTION50_CHOP1" |
| 48 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **unk_hash** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | A hash in some meshes, else 0 |
| 52 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **unk_zero** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x0 | Unknown purpose |
| 56 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **flags** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Unknown purpose |
| 60 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **num_draw_groups** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Amount of draw groups (records of the draw groups chunk) |
| 62 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **unk0** | 6 | Array of `3` items<br/>Item size: 2 bytes<br/>Item type: 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Unknown purpose |
| 68 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **unk1** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x0 | Unknown purpose |
| 72 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **bounding_box_min** | 12 | Point in 3D space (x,y,z), where each coordinate is: Float number (little-endian) | Bounding box of the vertices |
| 84 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **pad0** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x0 | Padding |
| 88 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **bounding_box_max** | 12 | Point in 3D space (x,y,z), where each coordinate is: Float number (little-endian) | Bounding box of the vertices |
| 100 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **pad1** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x0 | Padding |
| 104 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **transform** | 64 | Array of `16` items<br/>Item size: 4 bytes<br/>Item type: Float number (little-endian) | Transformation matrix 4x4, row by row, the position in the last row: where the mesh was in the modelling tool. Not used to draw it: scenery instances place meshes |
| 168 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **unk4** | 32 | Bytes | Unknown purpose |
### **Nfs6Ps2MeshTextures** ###
#### **Size**: 8..? bytes ####
#### **Description**: Textures of the mesh, referenced by index by draw groups ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **chunk_id** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x34006 | Chunk ID |
| 4 | **chunk_length** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Length of the chunk payload in bytes (everything after this field) |
| 8 | **textures** | (chunk_length/8)\*8 | Array of `chunk_length/8` items<br/>Item size: 8 bytes<br/>Item type: Array of `2` items<br/>Item size: 4 bytes<br/>Item type: 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Texture name hash (`name_hash` of the texture in a texture pack) and a value written by the game, per texture |
### **Nfs6Ps2MeshDrawGroups** ###
#### **Size**: 8..? bytes ####
#### **Description**: Draw groups of the mesh ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **chunk_id** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x34004 | Chunk ID |
| 4 | **chunk_length** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Length of the chunk payload in bytes (everything after this field) |
| 8 | **elevens** | up to 16-bytes alignment | Bytes | Alignment filler: a run of 0x11 bytes before the actual payload, so that the payload starts at an aligned offset |

### **Nfs6Ps2MeshDrawGroup** ###
#### **Size**: 64 bytes ####
#### **Description**: A run of VIF packets drawn with one texture: one call of the VU1 microprogram per packet, each packet a set of triangle strips of up to 40 vertices ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **texture_index** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Index of the texture in the textures chunk |
| 4 | **unk0** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Always 0x80008000 |
| 8 | **data_offset** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Offset of the VIF packets in the VIF data (after its alignment filler) |
| 12 | **num_qwords** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Length of the VIF packets in 16-byte units |
| 14 | **vu_flags** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | The VIF ITOP value of the packets: bits choose what the VU1 microprogram does (lighting, environment map...); 0x4100 when the packets have vertex normals |
| 16 | **bounding_box_min** | 12 | Point in 3D space (x,y,z), where each coordinate is: Float number (little-endian) | Bounding box of the vertices |
| 28 | **unk1** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Unknown purpose |
| 29 | **num_vertices** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Amount of vertices of all packets |
| 30 | **num_triangles** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Amount of triangles of all packets |
| 31 | **unk2** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Unknown purpose |
| 32 | **bounding_box_max** | 12 | Point in 3D space (x,y,z), where each coordinate is: Float number (little-endian) | Bounding box of the vertices |
| 44 | **vu_flags_2** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | The same as `vu_flags` |
| 48 | **unk3** | 16 | Bytes | Unknown purpose |
### **Nfs6Ps2MeshVifData** ###
#### **Size**: 8..? bytes ####
#### **Description**: Vertex data: a VIF code stream (UNPACK commands, MSCAL starting the VU1 microprogram after every packet) ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **chunk_id** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x34005 | Chunk ID |
| 4 | **chunk_length** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Length of the chunk payload in bytes (everything after this field) |
| 8 | **elevens** | up to 16-bytes alignment | Bytes | Alignment filler: a run of 0x11 bytes before the actual payload, so that the payload starts at an aligned offset |
| 8 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **data** | custom_func | Bytes | VIF codes and their data |
